metadata.description: Parameters for analyzing and generating text-based poetry styles across historical movements.

emotional_rawness.description: Measures the transition from objective philosophy to intense personal trauma/confession.

grammatical_abstraction.description: Measures how much the syntax is broken down, moving from clear narratives to abstract language play.

structural_rigidity.description: Measures adherence to formal rules, moving from organic free verse to strict mathematical/classical constraints.

rhythmic_urgency.description: Measures oral musicality, pacing, and suitability for spoken performance rather than silent reading.

digital_simplicity.description: Measures line brevity, minimal vocabulary, and structural optimization for smartphone screens.

movements.name: Stoicism
movements.one_liner: Logic, virtue, and mastering inner thoughts.

movements.name: Sufism
movements.one_liner: Seeking divine union through ecstatic love.

movements.name: Confessionalism
movements.one_liner: Direct, unflinching exposure of personal trauma.

movements.name: Language Poetry
movements.one_liner: Prioritizing word structure over clear meaning.

movements.name: New Formalism
movements.one_liner: Returning to traditional rhyme and meter.

movements.name: Spoken Word
movements.one_liner: Rhythmic text built purely for performance.

movements.name: Instapoetry
movements.one_liner: Minimalist, highly accessible emotional text snapshots.

creative_enrichment.image_seed: one concrete image the poem can open on — a thing, not a theme (a lamp, a pigment, a locked door).
creative_enrichment.volta: one candidate turn where the poem changes its mind, its light, or its register.
creative_enrichment.sonic_texture: the sound the poem leans on — assonance, hard consonants, a refrain, a repeated word.
creative_enrichment.line_gesture: whether the poem runs long and enjambed or breaks short; where the breath lands.
creative_enrichment.metaphor_family: one recurring image family the poem draws from, re-derived from its own material.
creative_enrichment.address: who the poem speaks to — the self, a 'you', an absent one, or the reader — left unresolved.
creative_enrichment.closing_move: how the poem ends open — a question, a paradox, a circular return, or a single word.
creative_enrichment.variety_note: one or two sentences on how this poem differs from its neighbours in image, opening, and closing.
